## UI evidence

## Checklist

<!-- Mark applicable items after verification; explain exceptions above. -->

- [ ] Core behavior and relevant risks are verified using existing tests, focused additions, or manual checks; results or limitations are recorded.
- [ ] UI evidence is attached where applicable; shared components, themes, localization, and accessibility are respected.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and changelog fragments are updated when required.
- [ ] Plugin metadata, runtime contracts, action policies, and minimum-host compatibility agree.
- [ ] Licensing and third-party notices are complete; no credentials, local configuration, or unrelated generated files are included.
